title: Work scheme — image-forward composition
question: Steer update: more impactful using real FISHEYE workscheme photography (measurements, layouts, viz tiles, site photos). Parchment Atelier stays. Priority: trust-schedule. Lock one structure.

options.label: Photo Ledger
options.thesis: Ruled stage ledger with oversized numerals — each major stage answers with a scrubbed authentic plate from the live workscheme.
options.viewport: Title + support; giant 01 beside body; first authentic site/measure plate opens under stage 01 — photography proves the schedule.
options.risk: Too many plates become a gallery; keep plates on key stages only.

options.label: Proof Map
options.thesis: Ten-stage index using live thumb plates, then a deep sequential read with larger process photography.
options.viewport: Title; 10-cell map of authentic thumbs (measure/layout/viz/site); first deep stage + large plate below.
options.risk: Thumb grid can feel like a stock mosaic if cells stay equal and tiny.

options.label: Plate Spine
options.thesis: Vertical schedule spine; stages hang as copy + alternating authentic plates so the timeline feels built, not typed.
options.viewport: Title; spine + stage 01 hanger with large site plate; later stages alternate copy/plate down the rail.
options.risk: Timeline chrome can read SaaS unless plates and type stay atelier-scale.
